name: GIN-Dock-Wallpaper
description: Unified Smart Hot-Corner Dock Bar & 4K Wallpaper Calendar HUD Engine for Windows 10/11
author: GinCz / Vladimir Bulantsev & Antigravity
features: Fixed Font Distortion: replaced OpenType variable font Bahnschrift with Tahoma, preventing text kerning bugs and letter overlapping
Active Theme Engine: fixed ThemeManager.GetTheme to correctly map selected theme buttons (Nordic Frost, Cyberpunk, Warm Sand, etc.) with real-time UI colors
Font Selector Relocation: moved 12 curated font preview buttons to Tab 1 (Главные) for intuitive centralized styling
Real-Time Live Dock Resizing: clicking 16px, 24px, 32px, 48px, 64px icon size buttons immediately resizes the dock bar and clears icon cache
Instant Mouse Hover Folder Opening: subfolders on the dock bar expand seamlessly on mouse glide without requiring mouse clicks
Localized Dock Placement Buttons: Russian UI now displays '⬆ Вверху' and '⬅ Слева' properly
Zero-Browser In-App Auto-Updater: direct in-place update engine with no web redirects
